_doc: Oregon authoring layout (tools/mapgen/DESIGN.md §4): units, floor frames, storeys, defaults and everything placed by hand. tools/mapgen compiles it with its parts to level.json (npm run mapgen); nothing here is loaded at runtime. Plan positions are u in the frame each record names (1F = world); heights and sizes are metres. Every placeholder is listed in _unverified (paths here, field names on records) and in research/OPEN_QUESTIONS.md; _sources says where each answer came from.

_sources.units.mPerU: research/oregon/layout_notes.md §1: the school bus is about 77 u long (ESTIMATE, ±15%)
_sources.frames.2F: tools/mapgen/extract xfloor.py: 22 + 18 stacked 1F/2F wall pairs, rms 0.29 / 0.31 u (extracted.json cross_floor)
_sources.frames.3F: assumed: the Cat Walk walls stand on the 2F tower walls (scale 1.0767 / 1.078), then the 2F frame
_sources.frames.B: alt since 2026-10-21 (D-095): the 1F-to-2F perspective step, which stacks the Tower, White and Armory stairwells on their 1F walls and lands hatches H2 and H3 clear of walls; identity (main) suited only H1, whose B square r6calls copied from 1F
_sources.spawns: r6calls insertion points (extracted.json points, EXT ip rects); lab spawn 0 is ours (P29)
_sources.rooms: research/oregon/layout_notes.md §2 (callouts: r6calls, and the official names of the eight bomb-site rooms; names keeps all three sources) and §4 (each seed is its room's box centre, in its floor's frame). B_FREEZER_HALL's callout is ours (r6calls leaves it unlabelled)
_sources.splits: research/oregon/layout_notes.md §6 open-plan links (OPEN rows), each on the wall lines beside it
_sources.softFloors: research/oregon/surfaces.md §4.2, each to its room's walls; Ubisoft's extents where they are larger, with r6calls' as alt (DESIGN amendment 7)
_sources.hatches: research/oregon/surfaces.md §5: r6calls' hatch squares (extracted.json fh/ch), world positions; H1 moved 7.1 u east to land inside B_ELECTRIC under the alt B frame (D-095)
_sources.floorShifts: Ulo 2026-10-28: walk #1 (a step where the Attic's hall opens into the Low Attic) and a phone screenshot after it (the part that is down raised to about vault height)
_sources.wells: research/oregon/layout_notes.md §4.4 and surfaces.md §4.1: the Cat Walk's centre (P21)
_sources.walls: walls_<floor>.json, seeded from extracted.json (r6calls floor rasters), research ids from surfaces.md §2 and layout_notes.md §6
_sources.stairs: research/oregon/layout_notes.md §5.1 footprints and the r6calls floor images (treads, landings, rails), placed where the stair rooms of the storeys they pass overlap (P19); S3 stacked: Ulo 2026-10-20; S2, S3 and S4 the other way round and every flight wall to wall: Ulo 2026-10-21 (D-095)
_sources.ladders: research/oregon/layout_notes.md §5.3 and the gap in the Cat Walk well's rail (walls_3F.json 3F.o001), P20
_sources.roofs: research/oregon/layout_notes.md §4.5 (footprints and names, the Dining and Meeting W roofs walkable at 2F level) and the r6calls and Ubisoft roof renders (ridges, flat parts), each rectangle on the outer faces of the walls under it; shapes, pitches and ceilings are ours (P24)
_sources.sites: research/oregon/layout_notes.md §3 (rooms, A and B as r6calls letters them); bombs at r6calls' bomb markers (extracted.json points, `from`), icon anchors (P30); Quick Match's pre-setups (`preSetup`, Phase 6 M5) are each site's first two `reinforce_priority` entries and its `rotation_holes` in research/oregon/common_setups.md (derived, DER), by the compiled panels' ids
_sources.cameras: research/oregon/map_features.md §2: r6calls' camera markers (extracted.json points, `from`); mounted by rule P31
_sources.ingredients: research/oregon/map_features.md §3: r6calls' extinguisher and gas-pipe markers (extracted.json points, `from`); mounted by rule P32
_sources.zones: research/oregon/map_features.md §10 candidates ([DER], UNVERIFIED), each at the doors and windows of the walls parts that match its row; boxes by rule P34
_sources.rappel: research/oregon/map_features.md §8: every roof edge anchors a rappel down the exterior wall under it, none refused until Ulo reports one (Q9)
